label: Gradient-as-default signal
why: A gradient is not wrong; it needs a brand or information purpose rather than acting as instant 'premium' decoration.
action: Keep only if it supports hierarchy, identity or information.

label: Rounded-card saturation signal
why: Large rounded containers are a common default when agents need a section but have not solved hierarchy.
action: Remove container chrome unless grouping genuinely needs a boundary.

label: Generic reveal animation signal
why: Repeated entrance motion can become decoration rather than explanation.
action: Keep movement only when it clarifies sequence, state, causality or focus.

label: Glass blur surface signal
why: One blurred surface can be a choice. Several at once is a common default look.
action: Keep it for one surface that needs depth from content behind it. Otherwise use a solid fill.

label: Colored glow shadow signal
why: A colored glow on many components adds decoration, not hierarchy.
action: Keep a glow only with a written reason; otherwise use a neutral shadow or none.

label: Default blue/purple gradient pair
why: These pairs are the most common agent default for brand color.
action: Use the project palette, or state why this pair is the brand.

label: Clickable non-control element
why: A div or span with a click handler has no role, focus or keyboard action by default.
action: Use <button> for actions or <a href> for navigation.

label: Image without alt attribute
why: Without an alt attribute a screen reader may read the file name.
action: Add a descriptive alt, or alt="" if the image is decorative.

label: Document without lang attribute
why: Screen readers and translation tools use lang to choose pronunciation and language.
action: Add lang to the html element.

label: Zoom blocked in viewport meta
why: Blocking pinch zoom stops low-vision users from enlarging the page.

label: Focus outline removed signal
why: Removing the outline is fine only if a visible focus style replaces it. This rule cannot tell whether one does.
action: Check by tabbing through the page that every control shows focus.

label: Sparkle icon or emoji signal
why: Sparkle marks are a common stand-in for "AI feature" without saying what the feature does.
action: Replace with an icon or words that match what the control does.
